svg.text: cre[ai]tion design pipeline - agent orchestration layer
One brief -> N production-ready variants. Deterministic orchestrator over a per-variant state machine; models only where judgement is needed.
PER BRIEF (once, shared by the fan-out)
todo plan, fan-out N style directions, fan-in, run budget, run-health breaker
VARIANT STATE MACHINE x N (immutable VariantState; pure reducer apply(state, outcome); deterministic router picks the next step)
guards: steps <= 18 | LLM revisions <= 3 | reviser tool calls <= 3 | oscillation (spec fingerprint repeats) | budget 80k tok / CNY 0.60 with 30% judge reserve
critic-and-revise loop: the critic is code (no run-to-run self-disagreement); the reviser is the only LLM in the loop
any exception -> error outcome, never escapes the worker;
idempotency key = H(run, variant, step, seq, inputs);
journal hit -> replay (no call, no charge)
offline: deterministic mock with per-model flaws
every LLM call goes through the gateway
Failure -> recovery (all paths covered by tests and the fault demo)
malformed JSON: parser recovers prose/fences -> schema repair x2 -> next model -> deterministic template
429 / 5xx / timeout: retry w/ backoff -> breaker opens -> fail fast to next route (no retry storm)
tool timeout/error: retry x3 -> snapshot / rate table / local rules -> degraded => NEEDS_HUMAN
loop cap, oscillation, budget: one deterministic baseline -> gate -> REJECTED with reason
DURABLE STATE (SQLite/WAL in the prototype; Postgres + object store + Redis in production)
Crash & resume (e.g. run of 40,000 dies at 31,000)
re-enqueue non-terminal variants only (indexed ledger query); in-flight variants replay
their journal through the same reducer; only steps in flight at the kill are re-run
bulkhead per variant | breakers per model/tool | AIMD + token bucket | run budget
run-health breaker (infra failures) | quality breaker per brief (repeated rejections)
recurring first-draft DFM failures become lessons; `teach` adds designer lessons;
written between runs only, so a fan-out never depends on finishing order
run -> brief -> variant -> step.* -> llm.call / tool.call
attrs: model, tokens, cost, attempts, repair, fallback_depth,
replayed, degraded; events: FAULT RETRY REPAIR CIRCUIT
variant p95 latency, cost/variant, pass rate,
breaker state, queue depth, judge drift
6 briefs incl. conflicting | schema, DFM, cost, conflict checks
judge vs deterministic GT (kappa), planted defects, self-consistency
chaos robustness | memory effect | diversity, headroom, segments
spans from the step executor, model gateway and tool executor
designer approval rate and time-to-approve | post-approval edit distance on specs | downstream CAD/tooling DFM escapes | quote vs estimate delta |
judge-vs-human agreement on a sampled 2% | diversity per brief | fallback/repair/route-fallback rates | canary vs control on all of the above
Production-ready := schema-valid AND all hard DFM rules pass (full-confidence engine) AND BOM <= ceiling (live prices) AND mass/envelope/packaging fit AND every must-preserve intent anchor traced
AND judge overall >= 3.5, brief_adherence >= 4, no criterion < 2 AND no degraded evidence AND no unresolved brief conflict AND a recorded approval.

Where the critic-and-revise loop earns its cost: DFM/cost (verifiable target, code critic, converges in <= 3). Single pass: interpretation (+ code cross-check), concept (fan-out + select), judge (noisy; no judge-driven loop), cost (arithmetic).

Chosen plain code over an agent for: routing/planning, constraint resolution, DFM critique, closed-form fixes, cost, gating, ranking, learning. Each has an exact answer; a model would only add cost and noise.
Prototype: Python 3.9+, Pydantic, asyncio, SQLite; offline mock by default, live DeepSeek (+ optional OpenAI judge) with --live. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the full design rationale.
